summary: A 17-year-old US student, Shiloh Attoun, discovered a 3,300-year-old Egyptian-style scarab amulet during a school excursion to Tel Gezer National Park in Israel. Archaeologists examined and dated the object before the Israel Antiquities Authority collected it for preservation. Attoun received a certificate of appreciation for reporting the discovery, which offers insights into ancient Egyptian cultural influence in the region.
